# Português
​
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.
​
Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.
​
**ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças.
​
**COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição**
​
As inscrições custam R$ 30,00 (trinta reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail).
​
O pagamento da inscrição dá direito a um acompanhante. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores  de 18 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento.
​
Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 40,00 (quarenta reais), caso haja vagas.
​
Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 15,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas.
​
**Estudantes do Colégio Integral terão desconto na inscrição, pagando uma taxa de R$ 15,00 (quinze reais) caso se inscrevam antes da competição e R$ 20,00 (vinte reais) caso se inscrevam no dia da competição.**
​
# English
​
Registration is open to any person, from any country.
​
To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge.
​
**ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.
​
**FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition**
​
Registration costs R$30.00 (thirty Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required).
​
Payment of registration fee guarantees the competitor a single companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 18, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event.
​
On-site registrations will be accepted for R$40.00 (fourty Brazilian reais), if there are still places.
​
Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places.
​
**Colégio Integral students will have a descount. They will pay R$ 15.00 (fifteen brazilian reais) if they register prior to the competition and R$ 20.00 (twenty brazilian reais) if they register on the spot.**

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Trondheim Sommerkubing 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.
 
### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSommerkubing2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.
 
### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSommerkubing2025#59464-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).
 
---
 
## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Trondheim Sommerkubing 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.
 
### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for this competition. We strongly advise all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSommerkubing2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.
 
### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSommerkubing2025#59464-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

items.information:
***English version is below***

**Deutsch:**
Wir freuen uns sehr euch Linz Summer 2025 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Das Turnier findet im Volkshaus Ebelsberg statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

English:
We are happy to announce the Linz Summer 2025 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

​
##### Español
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

¡Bienvenidos a **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**!

Cholula, sus 37 iglesias y sus aires prehispánicos están listos para recibirte en esta nueva competencia. 

 Tendrás una sola ronda para demostrar por que eres el mejor. Cada segundo y resolución será decisiva desde el primer intento. 
¿Tienes lo que se necesita para ser el más rápido? ¡Acepta el reto y gira hacia la victoria! Esto es, **¡Todo o Nada!**

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Municipo de  **"San Andrés Cholula"** y a la Presidenta Municipal **Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**.

Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 20215 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).
​

##### English
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Welcome to **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**!

Cholula, with its 37 churches and pre-Hispanic spirit, is ready to welcome you to this new competition.

You’ll have just one round to prove why you’re the best. Every second and every solve will be decisive from the very first attempt.
Do you have what it takes to be the fastest? Take the challenge and twist your way to victory! This is All or Nothing!

This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the Municipality of **San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres.**

Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information:
## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2025!
Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. 
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. 
Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj.
Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt.

Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte!

Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet.

Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). 

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2025!
Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience.
You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. 
There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories.
The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt.

Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts!

items.information:
## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025!
### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level.

[![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/)

![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png)

#### New Competitors:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

#### Free T-Shirt:
By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes).

#### Qualifications:
**3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them.

#### Spectators and Guests: 
Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book.

#### Prizes:
As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete.

#### Podium Positions:
If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round.

#### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025:
The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship.

#### Invitation Letters:
Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition).

#### Media Enquiries:

Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

items.name: Saint-Augustin A 2025
items.information:
## [FR]

### Série Saint-Augustin 2025

Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! 

Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents.

Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***.


### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

## [EN]

### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series

One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! 

You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets.

You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***


### Registration Reminders

You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

##### **German**
Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum dritten Mal findet Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events!

**Wichtig!**
Bei den letzten Competitions von Köln hatten wir in den ersten 5 Minuten über 150 Anmeldungen. Sorgt bitte dafür, dass ihr die Teilnahmegebühr **vor** der Online-Anmeldung bezahlt. Wenn Ihr überweisen müsst, macht das bitte 2-3 Tage vorher, damit die Zahlung rechtzeitig bei uns ankommt. Wir gehen wieder davon aus, dass auch Kölner Kubing 2025 innerhalb weniger Minuten voll sein wird!


**English**
Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! Kölner Kubing is taking place for the third time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event!

**Important!**

**Western Development Museum: The registration fee for this competition includes admission to the Western Development Museum for the competitors and their guests.** There will be a longer lunch break in the competition schedule so everyone can enjoy the museum. Learn more about the WDM at their website [here](https://wdm.ca/north-battleford/).

We ask attendees to limit themselves to two guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 240 people.
Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time.
Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in.

**First Time Competitors:**
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition.

**Megaminx and Square-1:**
There will be no cutoff for Megaminx or Square-1 at this competition. The cumulative time limit for megaminx is 30 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. Megaminx is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results.

**Draw prizes:** 
There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done.

**Notice of Filming and Photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Välkomna till Sörmland Open 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to Sörmland Open 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

**N.B.:** On Friday, only one attempt of 3x3 Multi-BLD will be held. If you do not want to compete in that event, you do not have to come already on Friday, it is enough that you arrive first before your first event starts on Saturday.

items.name: Spring Bozeman 2025
items.information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back to Bozeman for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations.
If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:45 AM.
If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 AM UTC 3-26-2025)
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.name: German Open 2025
items.information:
In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2025 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun!

Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2025 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

items.name: QBERS League In Astana 2025

venue.name: Kazakh Research Institute of Processing and Food Industry

items.information:
**Қазақша**

QBERS League In Astana 2025 – Астанадағы ашық жарыс.

Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 5000 теңгені құрайды. 

Жарыстың басты оқиғасы - QBERS League. QBERS League – турнирлік кронштейн форматында өтетін бейресми оқиға. QBERS League туралы қосымша ақпарат алу үшін қойындыларды қараңыз.

Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады.

**Русский**

QBERS League In Astana 2025 - это открытые соревнования в Астане. 

Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 5000.

Главная событие сорвенований - QBERS League. QBERS League - это неоффицальный ивент, который будет проводиться в формате турнирной сетки. Подробнее про QBERS League смотрите во вкладках.

Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM.

**English**

QBERS League In Astana 2025 is an open competition in Astana.

The base registration fee for any number of events is 5000 tenge.

The main event of the competition is QBERS League. QBERS League is an unofficial event that will be held in the format of a tournament grid. For more information about QBERS League, see the tabs.

These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

## [EN]

### Registration Reminders

**Registration will close on Wednesday April 23rd, 2025 at 10 pm (10 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

**Les inscriptions seront clôturées le mercredi 23 avril 2025 à 22h (10 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page.

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles).

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

	- Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará;
	- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado;
	- Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição;
	- Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados.

Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas.
Procure se divertir bastante!

### ENGLISH ###

Welcome to Rio Cubolympics 2025!
It will be a pleasure to welcome you.

**SEE THE UPDATES OF THE COMPETITIONS ON OUR INSTAGRAM**
**@riocubolympics**

Tips:

	- The cube you will compete with must be in good condition;
	- You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition;
	- If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates.

Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers.
Have a lot of fun!

#![Bandera ESP](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0E5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c7812c9b5d2929fb4ed7644517bf4f9800a3d1e4/esp.png) **Español**
Si eres socio de la **Asociación Española de Speedcubing (AES)** a día 13 de abril de 2025 y participas en la competición se te reembolsarán 2.5€ de la cuota de registro al finalizar ésta. Puedes hacerte socio de la AES pinchando [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).

El Corazón de la Axarquía 2025 se celebra en honor a Owen Pérez, un joven cubero que tristemente falleció de forma repentina en 2024. Owen compitió en el UMA Open 2023 y en el Écija Open 2024. Además de ser un talentoso cubero, era un chico inteligente, creativo y divertido, y se le echa mucho de menos.

---

#![Bandera UK](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0U5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a28e3c285bf55a2606838971abb0514d0ef172c/UK.png) **English**
If you are **Spanish Speedcubing Association (AES)** member on April 13, 2025 and you participate in the competition, you will be reimbursed €2.5 of the registration fee at the end of the competition. You can join AES by clicking [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).

El Corazón de la Axarquía 2025 is being held in honour of Owen Pérez, a young cuber who sadly suddenly passed away in 2024. Owen competed in the UMA Open 2023 and the Ecija Open 2024. As well as being a talented cuber, he was a smart, creative and fun boy, and he is greatly missed.

#Please check the schedule to find possible time slots.  Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in.
#Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1.  Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3.

- On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot.
- Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments.  We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed.  Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis.  If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot.
- If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly.

*In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.*

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png)

#This is an expo first!  We will have things planned between 3x3 groups that isn't competing!

- [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition!
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
- Spectators will have to pay entry to the expo.  Tickets may be purchased ahead of time at the [EVO Sports Expo website](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/p/santa-clara-evo-expo-ticket) for $30, or in person the day of.
- We urge competitors with spectators (especially minors) to not register for the first timeslot; however, a guardian (with a spectator ticket purchased) will be able to enter early with the competitors, it will be more straightforward to register for any timeslot but the first.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzIzNTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--dc05479e34fabbdd9670adb78e01bfe98d431584/nvchampslogo.png)

Welcome to Nevada Championship 2025! The first ever state championship held in Nevada!
The competition is open to all, but only Nevada residents are eligible for state champion titles. See NV Champion Eligibility for more info.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.


**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.


#### **How to Withdraw/Alter Registration**
Registered competitors withdraw/alter their registration by emailing the organisation team (unrcubing@gmail.com) the following:
1. Statement of intent to withdraw/alter registration.
2. Changes to registration (if applicable).
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.


#### **Staff Member Registration**
Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered a refunded registration fee in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition. 
For this competition all staff members must fill out the form in the Staff Applications tab. If you do not fill out this form you will not be able to staff this competition.
